### 16–24s — CN06-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · METHOD — How were answers tested?. Recover research, cut, drape, fitting, casting, collaboration, critique, rejection, and revision practices, including exceptions and contributor accounts.

### 24–32s — CN06-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · TRANSLATE — What changes in the new context?. Name new bodies, materials, technologies, laws, workers, audiences, and cultural authorities; explain what the inherited method cannot answer unchanged.

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CN06-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · CITE — Can evolution show its lineage?. Attach source, interpretation, transformation, contributor, permission, dissent, and successor rationale so continuity is neither copy nor amnesia.
